title: The Gilded Veil
author: Bram Vasquez
blurb: Kestrel Eriksen, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
